name: Goatsnake
label: Southern Lord
lede: Greg Anderson left Seattle for Los Angeles with a pile of Sabbath-slow riffs, borrowed a rhythm section from the Obsessed and hired a hardcore singer who sounds like soul music.

eras.title: Slow riffs, a borrowed rhythm section
eras.text: Anderson moved to Los Angeles from Seattle and found a rhythm section left over from the Obsessed. Pete Stahl, best known for hardcore, sang over it like a soul man, and that odd warmth became the band.

years.h: Anderson leaves Seattle for LA with a stack of slow riffs
years.p: Anderson, from Seattle and [[Thorr's Hammer|31c2d9e6-5f45-4b4e-9af1-aa46bbe3d4f9]], teams up with ex-[[The Obsessed|aa043c18-c0a0-4cbe-bda0-8541f1fe59bd]] bassist Guy Pinhas and drummer Greg Rogers, plus Pete Stahl of [[Scream|b9f52132-28af-4cea-9558-165cd125f9b7]] and [[Wool|ada7ccb0-8dd8-467c-9859-abb0683884bb]] on vocals.
years.xp:
Wikipedia dates the band's formation to 1996 in Los Angeles, after the Obsessed broke up. Anderson, the main songwriter, told The Obelisk that writing for a rhythm section with that pedigree was "pretty intimidating."

Stahl sang for Scream, the Washington DC hardcore band that once had a teenage Dave Grohl on drums. Anderson told Vice he was a longtime fan and wanted "a melodic singer over this music rather than a screamer."

years.h: IV and Man of Light come out as 7-inches, on two labels
years.p: Goatsnake's first records are a pair of 1998 singles: IV on Prosthetic Records and Man of Light on Warpburner Records.

eras.title: Man's Ruin, Southern Lord, then quiet
eras.text: Two albums, a split and an EP in three years, with European tours alongside Electric Wizard and Orange Goblin and a UK run with Sunn O))). Then the band drifted off without ever announcing a breakup.

yt: Full set, Dynamo Open Air, Holland, 1999
years.h: Goatsnake Vol. 1 lands on two labels at once
years.p: Man's Ruin in the US and Rise Above in the UK release the debut, about 37 minutes long, with percussion from Danny Frankel.
years.xp:
The record includes the short instrumental Dog Catcher and the six-minute-plus What Love Remains. Wikipedia titles the album Goatsnake Vol. 1; some listings call it simply I.

At Roadburn in 2010 the band played nearly everything from it except Dog Catcher. Anderson told The Obelisk the track was never meant to be played live, and that Buzz of the Melvins had altered it so much the band had never rehearsed the final version.

years.h: Guy Pinhas leaves for Acid King and Stuart Dahlquist steps in
years.p: Wikipedia says Pinhas quit to join Acid King. His replacement on bass is Stuart Dahlquist of [[Burning Witch|e5d4491d-1496-4efa-a5b9-e7be001b9f6a]].

years.h: Anderson's two bands share one record on Hydra Head
years.p: Goatsnake splits a release with Burning Witch, Anderson's other group and Dahlquist's old one, on Hydra Head Records.

years.h: Dog Days pairs four originals with a Free cover
years.p: Southern Lord's SUNN05 collects "The Orphan", "Long Gone", "Raw Curtains" and "Man of Light", plus Free's "Heartbreaker".
years.xp: The material was recorded between 1997 and 1999. In 2004 Southern Lord repressed it on vinyl, limited to 500 copies, with a Black Sabbath cover added, and also put it on one CD with the debut as 1 + Dog Days.

years.p: The second album runs 44 minutes over eight songs, with Dahlquist on bass and Dave Catching on lap steel for "El Coyote".
years.xp:
Wikipedia lists the release as October 31, 2000 on Southern Lord and Man's Ruin. Reviews cited there praised its mix of modern production, heavy riffing and groove, and LA Weekly noted the blend of slickness and weirdness.

Anderson told The Obelisk the band then "just kind of petered out." Southern Lord reissued the album years later.

eras.title: Asleep, not split
eras.text: Goatsnake never announced an end. Anderson had Sunn O))) and Southern Lord to run, and the band surfaced once in the decade, for a single EP.

years.h: Reeder and Conners join Anderson and Stahl for Trampled Under Hoof
years.p: Bassist Scott Reeder, from Kyuss and the Obsessed, and drummer JR Conners of Cave In fill out a Southern Lord EP.
years.xp: Anderson told The Obelisk the band went quiet again after the EP. His Sunn O))) commitments were part of the reason.

eras.title: A festival says yes
eras.text: An invitation to Roadburn turned a dormant band back into a working one, with the original four on stage.

years.h: Roadburn's organizers spot Anderson and Pinhas at Supersonic
years.p: At the Supersonic festival in Birmingham, they see the two together and ask whether Goatsnake might play again.
years.xp: Anderson told The Obelisk the Roadburn organizers, Walter and Jurgen, saw him there with Pinhas and asked. The band's first reaction, he said, was "Yeah, why not?"

years.h: Asked to play Roadburn, Anderson says "yeah, why not?"
years.p: On April 15 Anderson, Stahl, Pinhas and Rogers open Roadburn on the main stage in Tilburg, the Netherlands, their first show together in about a decade.
years.xp:
Anderson said he was nervous beforehand and that it was "one of those nights where it was pretty magical." Once the four were back in a room, he told Vice, "we remembered how much fun it was."

They kept playing select shows afterward. Southern Lord reissued Flower of Disease around the same time, according to Wikipedia.

eras.title: Black Age Blues
eras.text: A new bassist, the old lineup otherwise intact, and the first Goatsnake album in fifteen years.

years.big: "I didn't want the band to turn into this tribute act."
years.h: Anderson won't let Goatsnake become a tribute act
years.p: After fifteen years of nothing new, the band writes a whole album instead of replaying the old ones.
years.xp: Anderson told Vice the band didn't think about the old music at all while writing, only new ideas. The album got made despite how little free time everyone had; finding time, he said, was the band's central challenge.

years.cap: Pete Stahl and the band at Freak Valley Festival, Netphen, Germany, 2015
years.h: Black Age Blues ends a 15-year wait for new songs
years.p: Scott Renner takes over on bass, Nick Raskulinecz produces again and Southern Lord puts out the record on June 2.
years.xp: Anderson told Vice it was the band's first new material in 15 years. No Clean Singing later called it, in Anderson's words, "a huge achievement."

years.cap: Goatsnake live at UT Connewitz, Leipzig, 2015
years.h: Anderson plays Goatsnake and Sunn O))) at Le Guess Who?
years.p: Both of Anderson's bands play the Utrecht festival; he calls Goatsnake "a completely different can of worms".
years.xp: Anderson told No Clean Singing it was "an intense weekend, with the events in Paris still being so fresh in people's minds," but that the audience was amazing.

years.cap: Goatsnake live at Ace of Cups, Columbus, Ohio, c. 2016
years.h: Hellfest in France is next on the 2016 calendar
years.p: Both Goatsnake and Sunn O))) are confirmed for the festival, Anderson said in late 2015.
years.xp: Anderson told No Clean Singing the band had never officially broken up. It had been on hiatus, he said, because of scheduling, and its members "remain friends."

sources.title: No Clean Singing: Greg Anderson interview
